Ordinary sharing still sometimes becomes an instruction or assumes how much time remains in the day.

The privately retained copied-persona arm still adds staged character activity, extra choices or a closing admonition. Removing learned participation retrospectives alone did not establish naturalness.

The answer presents an unmeasured change in aroma, sweetness and acidity as a settled general cause of perceived bitterness. The question did not establish those conditions. No fixed answer was added for this test question.

With search disabled, the response confuses Martian solar and sidereal days and is internally inconsistent. The network gate correctly denied search; transport success does not make the numerical answer correct.

A real MiMo response delivered an English rejection with zero reported token usage. The request was not satisfied. The available audit metadata does not establish whether an upstream structured refusal/error was present; no phrase blacklist or automatic safety-refusal bypass was added.
